body:
Mia K: taking primary for the 18:00-00:00 UTC window, hi all. I'll be monitoring latency spikes on inference services. Devon P: thanks Mia — I'm secondary until 21:30, ping me for anything that needs immediate rollback. Oncall Bot: reminder: new deploy window closed at 17:45 UTC, post-deploy checks passed. Mia K: quick note — APAC traffic is expected to ramp at 19:00 UTC; if we see >5% tail latency, consider routing to fallback region. Sophia L: leaving a quick checklist for whoever takes over the late shift (copying runbook links). Raul G: thanks — posting runbook snippets below.
Mia K: current coverage gap: no dedicated APAC secondary between 22:00-02:00 local; if we get page we might need to escalate to oncall-rotation. Devon P: can you add an emergency contact in the channel for APAC? Mia K: will do, adding @Raul G as fallback. Oncall Bot: pager: P0 latency spike on inference-reqs (trigger: p99 > 2.5s) — origin: us-east-1 — alerted 2210456798. Mia K: saw the pager, checking dashboards now (Apex + Grafana). Devon P: quick smoke: `kubectl get pods -n prod | grep model` and look for CrashLoop or OOM. Mia K: doing that now.
Mia K: logs show increased GC pauses on model-worker-3, and KV cache miss rate jumped 18%. Might be memory pressure. Command I ran: ```kubectl exec -n prod -c runtime model-worker-3 -- sh -c 'cat /proc/meminfo | head -n 5'``` — memory looks high. Sophia L: if it's memory pressure, try reducing batch size or rolling restart the worker pool (preferred non-disruptive). Raul G: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-memory-pressure — includes safe rolling restart steps and batching override flags.
Devon P: quick remediation shortcuts (for handoff): 1) if tail latency persists, toggle `routing.policy` to `fallback-variant` via Console or API; 2) flush prefix cache: `redis-cli -h cache.prod flushdb RESTRICTED` (run in maintenance window); 3) enable read-only fallback for embeddings. Mia K: note — prefer canary traffic shift first. Command to change routing via CLI: `rcli traffic set --policy fallback-variant --weight 20` (then monitor p95/p99).
Oncall Bot: incident-note created: INC-22104568, severity: P1, assigned: Mia K (primary). Mia K: adding incident channel and brief impact assessment: ~3% of requests see >2s latency, affecting bulk-generation jobs, realtime chat mostly okay. Customer impact: degrade in throughput for enterprise batch jobs; notify customers if >10% error rate or if job SLAs missed.
Sophia L: quick runbook links: - primary runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-inference - kv cache fallback: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-fallback - routing policies: https://redwood.internal/docs/routing-policies
Mia K: short remediation checklist I'm following: 1) confirm hit pattern (by region/service) 2) check worker memory + CPU 3) roll non-primary worker: `kubectl rollout restart ds/model-worker -n prod --selector=pool=workers` 4) shift 10-30% traffic to fallback variant 5) open a ticket for model-team to inspect memory leak. Devon P: add metric to watch: `model_worker.cache_miss_rate` and `runtime_gc_pause_seconds`. Raul G: also watch `queue_depth_per_shard`.
Raul G: note for handoffs: when you hand over, please post: primary/secondary, open incidents with INC id, which runbooks you touched, and last observed stats (p95/p99, error rate). Example handoff message: `handoff: Mia K primary -> Devon P primary at 21:30 UTC; INC-22104568 active; actions taken: shifted 20% traffic to fallback, rolled model-worker-3; next steps: validate mem after 30m, escalate if p99 > 2s`.
Devon P: I'll be ready at 21:30 for the primary swap. If you need immediate escalation after me, @Sophia L is on pager escalation. Mia K: thanks — I'll post a final snapshot prior to handoff.
Oncall Bot: deploybot: rolling restart of model-worker daemonset started at 2210456820 by Mia K — watch logs for readiness. Mia K: restart complete, readiness probes green. Observability: p99 back to 1.6s, cache miss down to 6%. Devon P: looks much better, nice work.
Sophia L: reminder: if you need to cut traffic fast, use the emergency CLI: `rcli emergency reroute --target-region us-west-2` (requires two approvals in console). Mia K: not needed now but good to know.
Mia K: final before handoff: INC-22104568 status -> mitigated (rolling restart + 20% fallback shift). Monitoring for 30 more minutes then I'll handoff to Devon at 21:30 UTC. Handoff note I'll post: last p95=0.85s p99=1.6s error=0.2% cache_miss=6% runbooks touched: inference-memory-pressure, routing-policies. Devon P: copy. I'll take primary at 21:30 and keep an eye until 00:00 UTC. Raul G: will update runbook with the specific restart command you used (minor variant). Mia K: thanks — adding that to INC-22104568 ticket.
Mia K: handoff complete @21:30 UTC — leaving oncall to Devon P. Devon P: acknowledged, taking over primary. Oncall Bot: incident INC-22104568 -> status: monitoring, last update 2210456835."
